description: This Java test source file for the class ModelFormField in the org.apache.ofbiz.widget.model package contains unit tests for various functionalities of the ModelFormField class and its nested classes. It verifies behavior such as usedFields filtering, parameter name expansion, container ID substitution, and handling of target parameters in lookup fields.
